title: OpenKaava icon mark is black, not lighter tint, for WCAG 7.66:1 contrast on amber body
context: Material theme uses light tint for folder marks (2.08:1 contrast), but that disappears into the amber at 16px.
decision: Use black mark (#000000) on the H folder icon, giving 7.66:1 contrast. Paint mark as filled path, not knockout, for consistent contrast independent of background.
consequences: Icon reads clearly at all sizes and backgrounds. Sits above AAA minimum for graphical objects at all times.
